title: Control-Informed Constraint Adaptation in Minimum-Time Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racecars operate at the limits of vehicle dynamics, where small control errors translate into safety-critical behavior and lost performance. Trajectory planners assume perfect tracking and remain blind to execution errors. To guarantee safety, trajectory planners therefore restrict themselves to conservative spatial margins, leaving usable track space untapped. To overcome these issues, we introduce a control-informed online trajectory planning framework that learns from its own execution errors. By measuring systematic tracking deviations during runtime, we dynamically adapt spatial track constraints and iteratively expand the free-space planning area. The planner remains time-optimal while compensating for accumulated execution errors. This method was analyzed in a high-fidelity closed-loop simulation environment with autonomous racecars. The results demonstrate that our approach reduces lap time by 1.8\,s without increasing computational burden, maintaining a median runtime of 25 ms. Our finding indicates that feeding control-induced deviations back into the planning layer unlocks performance previously inaccessible to modular architectures and enables autonomous vehicles to exploit track limits systematically.
tldr: This paper introduces a control-informed online trajectory planning framework for autonomous racecars that adjusts spatial constraints based on real-time tracking errors, enabling safer and faster lap times without increased computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种控制感知的在线轨迹规划框架，通过实时跟踪误差动态调整空间约束，使自动驾驶赛车在无额外计算负担下实现更安全、更快的圈速。
summary_zh: 自主赛车运行于车辆动力学极限状态，此时细微的控制误差即会引发安全风险并导致性能损失。轨迹规划器假设完美跟踪而忽略执行误差，为确保安全被迫采用保守的空间裕度，导致可用赛道空间未被充分利用。为解决上述问题，我们提出一种控制感知的在线轨迹规划框架，该框架能够从自身执行误差中学习。通过实时测量运行过程中的系统性跟踪偏差，动态调整空间赛道约束并迭代扩展自由空间规划区域。该规划器在补偿累积执行误差的同时保持时间最优性。该方法在搭载自主赛车的高保真闭环仿真环境中进行了分析。结果表明，本方法在不增加计算负担的前提下将单圈用时降低1.8秒，中位运行时间稳定在25毫秒。研究揭示：将控制引发的偏差反馈至规划层，可释放模块化架构此前无法企及的性能潜力，使自主车辆系统性地利用赛道极限。

title: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved promising performance in robotic manipulation. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate generalization on static manipulation tasks and largely overlook dynamic interaction scenarios. To address this gap, we present ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical manipulation. ReflexBench contains six dynamic tasks and introduces an evaluation framework that decouples simulator stepping from robot control while supporting configurable latency under synchronous and asynchronous inference. Building upon ReflexBench, we propose ReflexVLA, an efficient VLA model designed for reaction-critical manipulation without large-scale robot-data pretraining. ReflexVLA enhances temporal reasoning through latent future prediction and multi-frame temporal fusion within the vision backbone, while reducing deployment latency through batched visual encoding and CUDA Graph replay. Experiments show that ReflexVLA consistently improves dynamic manipulation performance while maintaining competitive accuracy on standard static manipulation benchmarks, and real-world experiments further demonstrate its effectiveness under practical deployment conditions. Project website: https://reflexvla.github.io
tldr: This paper introduces ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical dynamic manipulation, and proposes ReflexVLA, an efficient VLA model with latent future prediction and multi-frame temporal fusion that improves performance on dynamic tasks while maintaining accuracy on static benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于反应关键型动态操作的ReflexBench基准，并提出了ReflexVLA，一种高效的VLA模型，通过潜在未来预测和多帧时间融合提升了动态操作性能，同时保持了在静态基准上的准确性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近期在机器人操作中取得了显著进展。然而，现有基准主要评估静态操作任务中的泛化能力，严重忽略了动态交互场景。为填补这一空白，我们提出ReflexBench——一个面向反应关键型操作的基准测试平台。该基准包含六项动态任务，并引入了一种评估框架，在解耦仿真步进与机器人控制的同时，支持同步与异步推理下的可配置延迟。基于ReflexBench，我们进一步提出ReflexVLA——一种无需大规模机器人数据预训练的高效VLA模型，专为反应关键型操作设计。ReflexVLA通过视觉骨干网络中的潜在未来预测与多帧时序融合增强时序推理能力，并通过批量视觉编码与CUDA图回放降低部署延迟。实验表明，ReflexVLA在保持标准静态操作基准中竞争力精度的同时，持续提升了动态操作性能，实际机器人实验进一步验证了其在真实部署条件下的有效性。项目网站：https://reflexvla.github.io

title: CORAL: Curriculum-Optimized Reward Adaptation for LiDAR-Based Goal-Directed Urban Driving
summary: Reinforcement learning is promising for autonomous urban driving, but long-horizon goal-directed navigation asks a policy to acquire several competing behaviors at once--reaching a distant goal, tracking a route, avoiding obstacles, obeying signals--and a fixed objective gives no order in which to learn them. This paper presents CORAL, which advances two schedules together: a five-stage curriculum that progressively lengthens routes and tightens behavioral constraints, and a stage-aware reward whose component weights shift emphasis from mission progress toward route following, safety, smoothness, and rule compliance as the task hardens. The policy is a multi-stream actor-critic network trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in CARLA on a compact 99-dimensional state pairing a polar LiDAR histogram with vehicle telemetry, ego-frame route geometry, and traffic-rule indicators--no point-cloud encoder, no bird's-eye-view rasterization. Against two PPO baselines under an identical protocol, CORAL reaches the goal in all twenty evaluation episodes on the longest routes under the full set of behavioral constraints, where the baselines reach 5% and 10%; a factorial ablation shows that neither schedule alone matches their combination: removing either lowers both success and route completion, and disabling both drops success to 55%. Trained in one town, the policy transfers zero-shot to seven unseen towns, succeeding in 68-98% of episodes on routes of the same 100-150 m length, with mean lateral deviation below 0.35 m.
tldr: CORAL introduces a curriculum learning framework with stage-aware reward adaptation for LiDAR-based urban driving, achieving near-perfect goal completion on long, constrained routes in CARLA and zero-shot transfer to unseen towns.
tldr_zh: CORAL 提出了一种基于课程学习与阶段感知奖励自适应的 LiDAR 城市驾驶方法，在 CARLA 长距离约束路线上近乎完美地完成任务，并零样本迁移至未见过城镇。
summary_zh: 强化学习对于自主城市驾驶具有潜力，但长时域目标导向导航要求策略同时习得多种竞争性行为——抵达远程目标、沿路线行驶、避开障碍、遵守信号——而固定目标无法确定这些行为的学习顺序。本文提出CORAL，同步推进两种调度机制：一个五阶段课程，逐步延长路线长度并收紧行为约束；一个阶段感知奖励，其组件权重随任务难度增加，将重点从任务进度转向路线跟随、安全性、平顺性和规则遵守。策略采用多流演员-评论家网络，在CARLA中使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练，基于紧凑的99维状态表示，该状态融合极坐标激光雷达直方图、车辆遥测、自车坐标系路线几何及交通规则指示——无需点云编码器或鸟瞰图栅格化。在相同协议下与两个PPO基线对比，CORAL在全套行为约束的最长路线上全部20个评估回合中均达成目标，而基线分别仅达到5%和10%；因子消融实验表明，任一调度单独使用均不及两者组合：移除任一调度会同时降低成功率和路线完成度，同时禁用两者则成功率降至55%。在一个城镇训练的策略可零样本迁移至七个未见过的城镇，在相同100-150米长度的路线上实现68-98%的回合成功率，平均横向偏差低于0.35米。

title: OccPlanner: Goal-Aware Occupancy-Conditioned Diffusion Planner for Pixel-Goal Navigation
summary: Pixel-goal navigation specifies targets directly in the agent's camera view, but a target pixel provides neither metric depth nor traversability, making 3D goal grounding and collision-free continuous planning challenging. We present OccPlanner, a goal-aware occupancy-conditioned diffusion planner that grounds pixel goals in egocentric metric space and sequentially conditions the goal representation on temporal visual context and learned local 3D occupancy features. To provide occupancy supervision at scale, we introduce L3ROcc, which converts monocular RGB navigation videos into robot-centric local 3D occupancy annotations through geometric reconstruction and ray-based visibility reasoning. We train OccPlanner on InternData-N1 and evaluate it in closed-loop simulation across four unseen scene categories from InternScenes and two goal-distance ranges. In the 5-8 m setting, OccPlanner increases the average success rate (SR) over NavDP from 20.81% to 71.55% across the four categories, reaching 86.20% and 84.92% in cluttered-easy and cluttered-hard scenes, respectively. Real-world open-loop experiments on a Unitree Go2 further provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer and adaptation with L3ROcc-generated supervision.
tldr: OccPlanner is a diffusion-based planner that grounds pixel goals in egocentric metric space using occupancy conditioning, achieving strong closed-loop navigation performance and demonstrating sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: OccPlanner 是一种基于扩散的规划器，通过占据条件将像素目标锚定在自我中心度量空间中，在闭环导航中取得了优异性能，并在 Unitree Go2 机器人上展示了仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 像素目标导航直接在智能体的相机视图中指定目标，但目标像素既不提供度量深度信息，也不提供可通行性信息，这使得三维目标定位和无碰撞连续规划面临挑战。我们提出OccPlanner，一种目标感知的占用条件扩散规划器，它将像素目标锚定在以自我为中心的度量空间中，并顺序地利用时间视觉上下文和学习到的局部三维占用特征来调节目标表征。为了在规模化范围内提供占用监督，我们引入了L3ROcc，该方法通过几何重建和基于射线的可见性推理，将单目RGB导航视频转换为以机器人为中心的局部三维占用标注。我们在InternData-N1数据集上训练OccPlanner，并在InternScenes数据集中四个未见过的场景类别及两个目标距离范围内进行闭环仿真评估。在5-8米距离设定下，OccPlanner在四个场景类别上的平均成功率（SR）较NavDP从20.81%提升至71.55%，在cluttered-easy和cluttered-hard场景中分别达到86.20%和84.92%。在Unitree Go2机器人上进行的真实环境开环实验，进一步初步验证了利用L3ROcc生成的监督数据可实现从仿真到现实的迁移与自适应。

title: FlatLab: A Unified Methodology Framework and Simulation-Based Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation of Flat Objects
summary: Robotic manipulation of flat objects is challenging due to the ungraspable configurations and strong variations in object geometry and material. Existing methods rely on heuristic pre-manipulation and are often evaluated in closed settings with limited generalization. We propose a unified framework that decouples the manipulation into a strategy generator and an action execution module. The strategy generator predicts appropriate manipulation strategies from object point clouds by learning strategy-centric, object-invariant representations via simulated data transformation and contrastive learning. Conditioned on the predicted strategy, the execution module decomposes long-horizon manipulation into reusable action primitives and dynamically composes them to generate stable trajectories. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce FlatLab, a comprehensive simulation benchmark for robotic flat object manipulation. FlatLab provides high-fidelity physical simulation of diverse rigid and deformable flat objects, automated multi-modal data collection, and standardized task definitions and evaluation protocols. Experiments conducted in FlatLab demonstrate that our approach generalizes effectively to unseen objects and categories, outperforming existing baselines. The project page and the code are provided at https://flatlab-web.github.io/.
tldr: This paper introduces FlatLab, a unified framework and simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation of flat objects, featuring a decoupled strategy generator and action execution module that learns object-invariant representations via contrastive learning and demonstrates generalization to unseen objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了FlatLab，一个面向机器人扁平物体操作问题的统一框架与仿真基准，通过对比学习学习对象不变表示，将策略生成与动作执行解耦，并在未见物体上展示了良好的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 机器人对扁平物体的操控因无法抓取的结构以及物体几何与材料的强烈变化而具有挑战性。现有方法依赖启发式的预操控，且通常在封闭环境中进行评估，泛化能力有限。我们提出一个统一框架，将操控过程解耦为策略生成器与动作执行模块。策略生成器通过仿真数据变换和对比学习，学习以策略为中心、与物体无关的表征，从而根据物体点云预测适当的操控策略。在预测策略的条件下，执行模块将长时域操控分解为可复用的动作基元，并动态组合这些基元以生成稳定轨迹。为支持系统性评估，我们引入FlatLab——一个面向机器人扁平物体操控的综合仿真基准平台。FlatLab提供对多种刚性及可变形扁平物体的高保真物理仿真、自动化多模态数据采集、标准化任务定义与评估协议。在FlatLab上开展的实验表明，我们的方法能有效泛化至未见过的物体及类别，并超越现有基线方法。项目页面与代码请见https://flatlab-web.github.io/。

title: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
summary: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data dependency. To demonstrate the advantages (high generalizability and low data dependency) of this framework, we first built a dataset of 30K tool-use trajectories and action demonstrations, which is much smaller than those used by baseline methods. We then designed a training regimen for long-trajectory tool-use reasoning in challenging environments. Experiments show that ART achieves a 20% higher success rate than mainstream baselines on simulation and real-world tasks, such as pick-and-place in the dark at novel viewpoints. Empirical results highlight the benefits of an agent-based approach: modular tool utilization enables more efficient training, lightweight deployment, and scalable integration of new tools. This design fosters robustness, adaptability, and extensibility, paving the way for the practical deployment of VLA systems in complex real-world scenarios.
tldr: Proposes ART, a framework that enhances VLA models with on-the-fly tool-use to reduce action complexity and data dependency, achieving higher success rates in simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出ART框架，通过动态工具使用增强VLA模型，降低动作复杂性和数据依赖，在仿真和真实任务中取得更高成功率。
summary_zh: 本文将端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与智能体工具使用相结合，提出了一种具备工具使用能力的智能体机器人（ART）。ART是一个工具注入框架，可对任意VLA模型进行调优，使其能够利用现成的工具模块实现低层视觉感知、高层功能推理及具身能力增强。与采用全连续动作解空间的传统VLA模型相比，ART通过工具使用降低了动作解空间的复杂度，不仅提升了跨任务的泛化能力，还降低了对数据量的依赖。为验证该框架的高泛化性与低数据依赖性优势，我们首先构建了一个包含3万条工具使用轨迹与动作演示的数据集，其规模远小于基线方法所用数据集。随后，我们针对复杂环境中的长轨迹工具使用推理设计了训练方案。实验表明，在仿真与真实世界任务中（如黑暗环境下新视角的抓取放置操作），ART的成功率比主流基线方法高出20%。实证结果凸显了基于智能体方法的优势：模块化工具利用可实现更高效的训练、轻量化部署以及新工具的可扩展集成。该设计增强了系统的鲁棒性、适应性与可扩展性，为VLA系统在复杂真实场景中的实际应用铺平了道路。

title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
summary: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands, and parallel grippers. Finally, we use domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific information in the learned visual representation. Experiments on hand-action prediction and real-world dexterous manipulation show consistent improvements over baselines, effective zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer, generalization to unseen objects and environments, and data-efficient few-shot adaptation.
tldr: AdvDex proposes a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for dexterous manipulation, featuring a large-scale multimodal human demonstration dataset (OmniShare), a canonical joint-aligned action space (JAAS) to align across embodiments, and domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific visual biases.
tldr_zh: AdvDex提出了一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架用于灵巧操作，包含大规模多模态人类演示数据集（OmniShare）、规范化的关节对齐动作空间（JAAS）以跨本体对齐，以及领域对抗学习以减少视觉表征中的本体特定偏差。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作是具身智能的一项基础能力，但由于机器人演示数据采集成本高昂且不同具身形态的动作空间存在差异，该能力的规模化发展仍面临挑战。基于异质数据训练的策略可能将任务相关视觉线索与特定具身形态的外观特征相纠缠，限制了跨具身形态的泛化能力。我们提出AdvDex——一个基于统一视觉-语言-动作框架的学习系统，可从人类与机器人演示中习得灵巧操作技能。首先，我们构建了OmniShare大规模多模态人类操作演示数据集，该数据集提供高质量运动学监督与触觉测量数据，同时降低了对机器人遥操作的依赖。其次，我们提出联合对齐动作空间（JAAS），这是一种规范化的动作表征方式，包含$\mathrm{SE}(3)$腕部姿态与15个手指关节，从而在功能层面统一了人类手部、灵巧机器手和平行夹爪。最后，我们采用领域对抗学习技术，减少所学视觉表征中的具身形态特异性信息。在手部动作预测及真实世界灵巧操作实验中的结果表明，本方法在基准测试中持续获得性能提升，实现了零样本人类到机器人的技能迁移，可泛化至未见物体及环境，并具备数据高效的少样本适应能力。

title: BICPO-VLA: Behavior-Identified Continuation Preference Optimization for Smooth Asynchronous Vision-Language-Action Control
summary: The request-to-handoff gap has three coupled sources: ambiguity about the behavior intended at request time, physical-state drift accumulated during action generation, and residual incompatibility when the new action finally assumes control. BICPO-VLA addresses them in sequence. First, an instruction-aware causal history encoder identifies the behavior supported by the command and current task progress. Second, sequential Haar subspace generation decomposes each action chunk into complementary pairwise scaffold and residual coefficients, enabling two specialized generation stages followed by exact reconstruction. By reducing iterative refinement in the original action space, it shortens the interval over which the robot continues moving before the new chunk becomes available. Finally, BICPO rolls the known outgoing actions to the actual handoff state and applies reference-relative Flow-DPO among behaviorally matched candidates, adapting the generated chunk to the remaining request-to-handoff mismatch without changing its intended behavior.
tldr: BICPO-VLA introduces a three-stage method to smooth the request-to-handoff gap in asynchronous VLA control by encoding intended behavior, decomposing action chunks via Haar transforms for faster generation, and adapting outputs via reference-relative Flow-DPO.
tldr_zh: BICPO-VLA 通过编码预期行为、利用 Haar 变换分解动作块以加速生成、以及通过参考相对 Flow-DPO 适配输出，三阶段平滑异步 VLA 控制中的请求‑移交间隙。
summary_zh: 请求到交接的间隙包含三个耦合来源：请求时刻意图行为的不确定性、动作生成过程中累积的物理状态漂移，以及新动作最终接管时残留的不兼容性。BICPO-VLA依次解决这些问题。首先，指令感知的因果历史编码器识别指令支持的行为及当前任务进度。其次，序列化哈尔子空间生成将每个动作块分解为互补的成对支架系数与残差系数，实现两个专门的生成阶段及随后的精确重构。通过减少原始动作空间中的迭代优化，该方法缩短了新动作块可用前机器人持续移动的时间间隔。最后，BICPO将已知的退出动作滚动至实际交接状态，并在行为匹配的候选动作间应用参考相对Flow-DPO，使生成的动作块适应剩余请求到交接的不匹配，同时不改变其预定行为。

title: Knowledge-Data-Dual-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Control in Mixed Traffic
summary: In mixed traffic, decision-making for autonomous vehicles (AVs) confronts three interrelated challenges. First, physics-based priors incorporated into reinforcement learning (RL) models fail to capture latent interactive vehicle intentions and diverse driver behaviors, limiting the proactive reasoning capabilities. Second, abrupt maneuvers by surrounding vehicles cause non-stationarity, leaving long-tail safety events under-explored. Third, hybrid action spaces destabilize unified RL training due to the different temporal scales of continuous car-following and discrete lane-changing maneuvers. To address these issues, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-driven Reinforcement Learning (KDDRL). First, a conditional deep generative model synthesizes intention-aware future trajectories, converting passive perception into proactive predictive states. Second, a knowledge-data dual-driven paradigm operates on these predictive states, fusing probabilistic data-driven insights with physical constraints to guide safe exploration through safety-critical scenarios. Third, a coupling module compresses both intention-aware trajectories and physical constraints into compact shared embeddings. This unified representation enables asynchronous multi-timescale optimization of continuous car-following and discrete lane-changing while preserving mutual information. Evaluations on dataset-calibrated simulations demonstrate that KDDRL effectively handles intention uncertainty, accelerates training convergence, and outperforms conventional baseline methods in terms of safety, efficiency, and comfort.
tldr: This paper introduces KDDRL, a knowledge-data-dual-driven reinforcement learning framework that integrates conditional generative models and physical constraints to handle intention uncertainty, non-stationarity, and hybrid action spaces in autonomous vehicle control within mixed traffic.
tldr_zh: 本文提出KDDRL，一种知识-数据双驱动强化学习框架，通过融合条件生成模型与物理约束，应对混合交通中自动驾驶决策的意图不确定性、非平稳性和混合动作空间挑战。
summary_zh: 在混合交通流中，自动驾驶汽车决策面临三个相互关联的挑战。首先，融入强化学习模型的物理先验知识无法捕捉潜在的交互性车辆意图及多样化驾驶行为，限制了主动推理能力。其次，周围车辆的突发性操控导致非平稳性，使得长尾安全事件难以充分探索。第三，由于连续跟驰与离散变道操控的时间尺度差异，混合动作空间会导致统一强化学习训练不稳定。针对这些问题，本文提出知识-数据双驱动强化学习框架。首先，条件深度生成模型合成意图感知的未来轨迹，将被动感知转化为主动预测状态。其次，知识-数据双驱动范式作用于这些预测状态，融合概率性数据驱动洞察与物理约束，引导安全关键场景下的安全探索。第三，耦合模块将意图感知轨迹与物理约束压缩为紧凑的共享嵌入表征。该统一表征支持连续跟驰与离散变道在异步多时间尺度上的优化，同时保持互信息。基于数据集标定仿真的评估表明，KDDRL能有效处理意图不确定性，加速训练收敛，并在安全性、效率与舒适性方面超越传统基线方法。

title: Graph-MambaNav: Spatial-Temporal Graph Mamba Leveraging Object-Relation Knowledge for Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Object-goal navigation requires an agent to reason over object relationships and prioritize target-relevant objects for efficient decision making in unseen environments. While existing graph-based methods incorporate target-awareness at the feature or attention level, they remain permutation-invariant and lack an explicit mechanism to control information propagation order, limiting their ability to model target-dependent importance and long-range dependencies. In contrast, Graph-Mamba highlights that node prioritization through sequence ordering is critical for effective global reasoning. In this work, we investigate the node prioritization mechanism in Graph-Mamba and study its role in object navigation. We propose Graph-MambaNav, a target-aware spatial-temporal graph encoding framework that introduces a heuristic ordering over objects based on their relevance to the target, allowing more informative objects to be processed later to aggregate richer context. Both node ordering and edge weights are initialized from LLM-derived commonsense object relationships, providing a unified prior for structured reasoning. A spatial module integrates local message passing with global GraphMamba-based selective scanning, while a temporal module applies Mamba-based sequence modeling over object-wise temporal orders, allowing selective aggregation of historical context for long-range temporal reasoning. Experiments on AI2-THOR and RoboTHOR demonstrate improved navigation performance with generalization, and additional real-world robot deployment further validates the effectiveness of our proposed approach.
tldr: Graph-MambaNav introduces a spatial-temporal graph framework with node prioritization based on target relevance and LLM-derived object knowledge for object-goal navigation, achieving improved performance in both simulation and real-world robot deployment.
tldr_zh: Graph-MambaNav 提出了一种基于目标相关性和LLM常识的空间-时间图框架，通过节点优先级排序和选择性扫描增强对象目标导航，在仿真和真实机器人部署中均取得更好性能。
summary_zh:
**摘要：**
目标导向导航要求智能体在未知环境中推理物体间关系，并优先关注与目标相关的物体，从而做出高效决策。现有基于图的方法虽在特征或注意力层面引入了目标感知，但仍保持排列不变性，缺乏显式机制来控制信息传播顺序，因而难以建模目标依赖的重要性和长程依赖关系。相比之下，Graph-Mamba 强调通过序列排序实现节点优先级划分，这对有效的全局推理至关重要。本文研究了 Graph-Mamba 中的节点优先级机制，并探讨其在物体导航中的作用。我们提出 Graph-MambaNav，一种目标感知的时空图编码框架，该框架根据物体与目标的相关性引入启发式排序，使信息量更丰富的物体在后续阶段处理，从而聚合更丰富的上下文。节点排序和边权重均由大语言模型推导出的常识性物体关系初始化，为结构化推理提供统一的先验知识。空间模块将局部消息传递与基于 Graph-Mamba 的全局选择性扫描相结合，时间模块则对物体维度的时序进行基于 Mamba 的序列建模，实现对历史上下文的选择性聚合，以支持长程时序推理。在 AI2-THOR 和 RoboTHOR 上的实验表明，所提方法在导航性能上有所提升且具备泛化能力，额外的真实机器人部署进一步验证了其有效性。

title: hint$^2$: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
summary: A central goal of robot learning is to enable robots to execute rich instructions specified at runtime. Large-scale language-conditioned policies have made substantial progress toward this goal, yet still struggle with temporal structure and safety constraints. Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) provides a powerful language to express complex, non-Markovian instructions. However, guiding learned manipulation policies toward LTL satisfaction remains challenging because modern policies generate short-horizon action chunks and replan in closed loop, while almost all LTL specifications are evaluated over long-horizon trajectories. In this paper, we introduce hint$^2$, a method for guiding short-horizon policies toward satisfying complex LTL specifications at inference time using hierarchical world models. Our key idea is to derive two separate guidance objectives using each world model's abstraction level. A high-level model predicts future action-induced transitions in task-relevant atomic propositions to guide progress through the LTL automaton, while a low-level dynamics model predicts immediate state evolution for accurate local safety guidance. Our results show that hint$^2$ overcomes the limitations of current LTL-guided diffusion methods, outperforms existing inference-time steering methods in CALVIN, and successfully completes instructions with complex liveness and safety constraints more elegantly than language-conditioned alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that hint$^2$ can handle complex instructions on a real UR5e manipulator.
tldr: Introduces hint^2, a method using hierarchical world models to guide short-horizon robot policies toward satisfying Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specifications at inference time, combining high-level LTL automaton guidance with low-level safety guidance.
tldr_zh: 提出hint^2方法，利用分层世界模型在推理时引导短视机器人策略满足线性时序逻辑规范，结合高层LTL自动机引导和低层安全引导。
summary_zh: 机器人学习的核心目标之一是使机器人能够执行运行时指定的复杂指令。大规模语言条件策略已为实现这一目标取得实质性进展，但在处理时间结构和安全约束方面仍面临挑战。线性时序逻辑（LTL）为表达复杂的非马尔可夫指令提供了强大的语言工具。然而，由于现代策略生成短时域动作片段并在闭环中重新规划，而几乎所有LTL规范均基于长时域轨迹进行评估，因此引导学习型操作策略满足LTL要求仍颇具难度。本文提出hint$^2$方法，通过分层世界模型在推理阶段引导短时域策略满足复杂LTL规范。核心思想在于：利用各世界模型的抽象层级推导出两种独立的引导目标。高层模型预测与任务相关原子命题中未来由动作引发的状态跃迁，以引导LTL自动机中的进程推进；低层动力学模型则预测即时状态演化，以实现精确的局部安全引导。实验结果表明，hint$^2$克服了当前LTL引导扩散方法的局限性，在CALVIN基准中优于现有推理阶段转向方法，且能比语言条件替代方案更优雅地完成包含复杂活性与安全约束的指令。最后，我们证明hint$^2$可在真实UR5e机械臂上处理复杂指令。

title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
summary: Action-conditioned video world models require low-latency causal generation and reliable responses to game-native controls. Although causal distillation enables one- or few-step video synthesis, extending it to interactive world models remains challenging, as discrete keyboard states and continuous mouse motion must remain aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks during causal training and autoregressive rollout. We introduce ForgeWM, a progressive framework that transforms a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into efficient few-step world models through domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching with a bidirectional teacher. The resulting budget-specialized students operate at steady-state denoising budgets of 1, 2, and 4 steps. ForgeWM further supports a dual-path deployment protocol combining latency-critical interaction with optional replay-time refinement, where the one-step student re-noises and refines its saved draft. On paired Minecraft trajectories, ForgeWM leads the evaluated systems in Imaging Quality, reference-aligned motion-profile agreement, action-sign accuracy, and mouse-control accuracy, while achieving the lowest reference LPIPS; the same four-stage recipe transfers to gamepad-controlled FPS gameplay. Replay-time refinement matches four-step reference quality while remaining roughly three times closer to the experienced trajectory than regeneration from noise. These results demonstrate ForgeWM's effectiveness for controllable few-step video generation.
tldr: ForgeWM introduces a progressive training framework that converts a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into a few-step causal world model for interactive environments, demonstrating improved image quality and action control on Minecraft and FPS gameplay.
tldr_zh: ForgeWM 提出了一种渐进式训练框架，将双向动作条件视频生成器转换为少步因果世界模型，用于交互环境，在 Minecraft 和 FPS 游戏中提升了图像质量和动作控制。
summary_zh: 动作条件视频世界模型需要低延迟的因果生成以及对游戏原生控制的可靠响应。尽管因果蒸馏能够实现单步或少量步数的视频合成，但将其扩展到交互式世界模型仍具有挑战性，因为在因果训练和自回归展开过程中，离散的键盘状态与连续的鼠标运动必须与时间上压缩的潜在块保持对齐。我们提出ForgeWM，这是一个渐进式框架，通过域适应、教师强制因果训练、因果一致性蒸馏以及与双向教师策略内分布匹配，将双向动作条件视频生成器转化为高效的少量步数世界模型。由此产生的预算专用学生模型以1步、2步和4步的稳态去噪预算运行。ForgeWM还支持双路径部署协议，将延迟关键交互与可选的回放细化相结合，其中单步学生模型对其保存的草稿进行重新噪声化并细化。在配对的《我的世界》轨迹上，ForgeWM在成像质量、参考对齐运动轮廓一致性、动作信号准确性以及鼠标控制准确性方面领先于所评估的系统，同时实现了最低的参考LPIPS值；同样的四阶段方案也适用于手柄控制的FPS游戏。回放细化可达到四步参考质量，同时与经历轨迹的接近程度大约是从噪声重新生成的轨迹的三倍。这些结果证明了ForgeWM在可控少量步数视频生成中的有效性。

title: GhostPoint: Self-Supervised Representation Learning by Hallucinating Occluded LiDAR Structure
summary: 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds is a core problem in autonomous driving. Recent advances in self-supervised learning (SSL) enable scalable pretraining and transfers well to per-point tasks such as semantic and panoptic segmentation, but transfer to 3D detection remains weaker. We analyze recent SSL methods and find that most objectives are defined only on measured LiDAR returns from visible surfaces, leaving occluded and unobserved regions unconstrained. This visible-surface bias can be sufficient for point-wise prediction, but 3D detection requires robustness to missing structure. To address this gap, we propose GhostPoint, an SSL framework that hallucinates latent features in local neighborhoods around discovered instances, generated via a novel instance voxel dilation. In GhostPoint, an encoder processes observed returns, and an additional predictor infers neighborhood representations from observed context. In addition to standard encoder-level supervision, we introduce a predictor-level supervision scheme on sampled voxels from generated neighborhoods. Specifically, observed (visible/masked) voxels match teacher-encoder targets, while unobserved voxels match teacher-predictor hallucinations. This design encourages the learned representation to explicitly model structure beyond observed returns. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently improving downstream 3D detection, especially under sparse scans and limited labels.
tldr: GhostPoint proposes a self-supervised learning framework for LiDAR point clouds that hallucinates latent features in occluded regions to improve 3D object detection, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo.
tldr_zh: GhostPoint 提出了一种针对 LiDAR 点云的自监督学习框架，通过在遮挡区域中幻化潜在特征来改进 3D 目标检测，在 nuScenes 和 Waymo 上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 基于LiDAR点云的三维目标检测是自动驾驶领域的核心问题。自监督学习（SSL）的最新进展实现了可扩展的预训练，并能很好地迁移至逐点任务（如语义分割和全景分割），但其向三维检测的迁移效果仍较弱。我们通过分析近期SSL方法发现，大多数目标函数仅定义在可见表面测量到的LiDAR回波上，导致遮挡区域和未观测区域缺乏约束。这种可见表面偏差虽足以支撑逐点预测，但三维检测要求对缺失结构具有鲁棒性。为解决这一差距，我们提出GhostPoint——一种通过新颖的实例体素膨胀在已发现实例的局部邻域中生成潜层特征的SSL框架。在GhostPoint中，编码器处理观测回波，附加预测器从观测上下文中推断邻域表示。除标准编码器级监督外，我们还对生成邻域中的采样体素引入了预测器级监督方案。具体而言，观测（可见/掩蔽）体素匹配教师编码器的目标，而未观测体素则匹配教师预测器的幻觉特征。这种设计促使学到的表示显式建模超出观测回波之外的结构。在nuScenes和Waymo上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能，特别是在稀疏扫描和有限标签条件下，持续提升了下游三维检测任务的表现。

title: SSP: An Event-Matched Syn2Sim2Phy Cross-Domain Evaluation Framework for Autonomous Driving VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving jointly produce scene interpretation, language-based reasoning, and driving trajectories. Existing evaluations often use independently selected synthetic, simulated, and physical data, so measured performance gaps can be confounded by changes in scenario content rather than genuine domain sensitivity. We propose SSP (Synthetic-Simulation-Physical), an event-matched Syn2Sim2Phy evaluation framework that anchors cross-domain comparison to the same safety-critical interaction. Starting from a synthetic long-tail video, SSP builds a validated event specification that preserves road topology, participant roles, relative motion, conflict evolution, passing order, response constraints, and event phases. Platform-specific realizations are then constructed in CARLA and on a closed proving ground and are evaluated only after transfer audits confirm preservation of mandatory event properties. SSP maps heterogeneous outputs from OpenEMMA, LLaViDA, and Alpamayo-R1 into common semantic slots and a 1 s trajectory window to assess output validity, semantic accuracy, critical-interaction recognition, trajectory quality, and risk response. Across Cut-in and vulnerable-road-user crossing cases, the macro-averaged Integrated VLA Capability Scores are 0.259, 0.291, and 0.325 in the Synthetic, Simulation, and Physical domains, respectively, while the best domain varies by scenario. Alpamayo-R1, OpenEMMA, and LLaViDA obtain scores of 0.405, 0.338, and 0.131. SSP provides a reproducible scene-transfer chain and an evidence-qualified evaluation of VLA behavior without assuming that the Physical domain is universally superior.
tldr: SSP proposes an event-matched cross-domain evaluation framework for autonomous driving VLA models, enabling controlled comparison across synthetic, simulated, and physical domains by anchoring on the same safety-critical scenario.
tldr_zh: SSP提出了一种事件匹配的跨域评估框架，用于自动驾驶VLA模型，通过锚定相同的安全关键场景，实现了合成、仿真和物理领域间的受控比较。
summary_zh: 用于自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可同时生成场景解读、基于语言的推理和驾驶轨迹。现有评估方法往往独立选取合成数据、仿真数据和物理实测数据，因此所测得的性能差异可能混杂了场景内容的变化，而非真正的领域敏感性。我们提出SSP（合成-仿真-实测）框架，这是一种事件匹配的Syn2Sim2Phy评估框架，将跨领域比较锚定于同一安全关键交互事件。SSP从合成长尾视频出发，构建一套经过验证的事件规范，该规范保留了道路拓扑结构、参与者角色、相对运动关系、冲突演变过程、通行次序、响应约束条件及事件阶段。随后在CARLA仿真平台和封闭测试场中构建面向具体平台的实现，并仅在迁移审计确认强制性事件属性得以保留后才进行评测。SSP将OpenEMMA、LLaViDA和Alpamayo-R1的异构输出映射到统一语义槽位和1秒轨迹窗口，以评估输出有效性、语义准确性、关键交互识别能力、轨迹质量及风险响应。在切入场景和弱势道路使用者横穿场景中，合成域、仿真域和实测域的宏平均综合VLA能力评分分别为0.259、0.291和0.325，而最佳领域因场景而异。Alpamayo-R1、OpenEMMA和LLaViDA的评分分别为0.405、0.338和0.131。SSP提供了可复现的场景迁移链，并在不预设实测域普遍优越的前提下，对VLA行为进行基于证据的资质化评估。

title: Spatiotemporal Tube-Based Safety-Certificate for Autonomous Navigation of Articulated Vehicles
summary: Articulated vehicles are the workhorses of freight transportation, and their autonomous navigation is challenging. Their physical characteristics and motion constraints pose significant challenges in manoeuvring these vehicles on narrow routes. This paper presents a spatiotemporal tube-based approach to plan autonomous navigation of vehicles like tractor semi-trailers, truck/ tractor trailers, towing Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), and road trains. This planning approach provides a certified path plan for the truck or tractor, ensuring that the towed series of trailers always remains within the road corridor, limited by permissible corrections. The planning leverages the kinematics of the linked elements along with sway constraints to arrive at a safe tube for the actuated prime mover. We modify the spatiotemporal tube using permissible corrections to provide a route safety certificate to the vehicle for the given route. The proposed planning method is verified on a truck-trailer navigation simulation for a complex route.
tldr: This paper proposes a spatiotemporal tube-based safety-certificate planning method for autonomous navigation of articulated vehicles, ensuring the towed trailers remain within road corridors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于时空管道的安全证书规划方法，用于铰接式车辆的自主导航，确保被拖挂的拖车始终保持在道路走廊内。
summary_zh: 铰接式车辆是货运运输的主力，其自主导航具有挑战性。这类车辆的物理特性和运动约束使其在狭窄路线上机动时面临重大难题。本文提出一种基于时空管道的规划方法，用于实现牵引式半挂车、卡车/牵引车挂车、自动导引车（AGV）拖挂组以及公路列车等车辆的自主导航。该规划方法为卡车或牵引车提供经认证的路径规划，确保被拖挂的系列挂车始终保持在道路边界内，且受限于允许的修正幅度。规划过程利用链接构件的运动学特性及侧摆约束，为驱动的牵引车构建安全管道。通过引入允许修正量对时空管道进行优化，为车辆在指定路线上提供路线安全认证。所提出的规划方法已在复杂路线的卡车-挂车导航仿真中得到验证。

title: Ensuring Safe Physical AI in Urban Mobility via Hazard-Informed Synthesized Envelopes
summary: As heterogeneous robotic systems deploy across diverse urban zones, maintaining safety amid complex human-robot interactions remains a critical challenge. We present a unified framework that bridges systematic hazard analysis and runtime enforcement using hazard-informed safety envelopes. Rather than treating safety as a static constraint isolated within individual software modules, we introduce a cross-layer safety transformation process spanning symbolic, spatial, and dynamic world models. We show how this representation naturally interfaces with physical AI runtime harnesses to guarantee safe urban mobility.
tldr: Proposes a unified safety framework using hazard-informed safety envelopes that integrate symbolic, spatial, and dynamic world models for safe urban mobility of heterogeneous robots.
tldr_zh: 提出一种统一的框架，通过整合符号、空间和动态世界模型来生成危险知悉的安全包络，确保异构机器人在城市环境中的安全运行。
summary_zh: 随着异构机器人系统在城市各区域的广泛部署，如何在复杂的人机交互中维持安全性仍是一项关键挑战。我们提出了一种统一框架，通过基于危险信息的安全包络，将系统性危险分析与运行时执行相衔接。不同于将安全视为孤立于单个软件模块内部的静态约束，我们引入了一种跨层级的安全转换过程，涵盖符号化、空间及动态世界模型。我们展示了该表示方法如何自然对接物理AI运行时框架，从而保障城市环境中的安全机动性。

title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
summary: Fine-grained robotic evaluation matters for understanding embodied models, going beyond binary success rates and rule-based process scores. We present PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5, a toolkit for robot process assessment that turns rollout videos into dense progress curves and derives multiple fine metrics. PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5 introduces three metrics, building on version 1.0, that characterize failure-side progress, post-drawdown recovery, and success-side execution quality, helping users understand embodied model capability. Based on the rollout videos from benchmarks, we perform a comprehensive assessment of the embodied models, providing some fine-grained metric results and key findings. We further introduce RoboPulse++ to evaluate the reliability of process reward models (PRM), providing evaluators with a more accurate testing platform. Moreover, we release a user-friendly assessment suite, including the benchmark, metric implementation, and visualization tools, to support reproducible manipulation process evaluation. We call on the community to rethink how robots are evaluated and establish transparent, procedural, and reproducible assessment as a foundation for the next generation of embodied intelligence.
tldr: Introduces a toolkit for fine-grained robot process assessment using dense progress curves and multiple metrics, along with a reliability evaluation platform for process reward models.
tldr_zh: 提出了用于细粒度机器人过程评估的工具包，利用密集进度曲线和多种指标，并提供了过程奖励模型的可靠性评估平台。
summary_zh: 细粒度机器人评估对于理解具身模型至关重要，其意义超越了二元成功率与基于规则的流程评分。我们提出PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5——一套机器人流程评估工具包，可将运行视频转化为密集的进度曲线，并衍生出多项细粒度指标。在1.0版本基础上，该工具包新增三项指标：表征失败侧进展、资金回撤后恢复能力以及成功侧执行质量，从而帮助用户深入理解具身模型能力。基于基准测试中的运行视频，我们对具身模型进行了全面评估，获得了若干细粒度指标结果与关键发现。我们进一步引入RoboPulse++来评估过程奖励模型（PRM）的可靠性，为评估者提供更精确的测试平台。此外，我们发布了包含基准测试、指标实现与可视化工具的用户友好型评估套件，以支持可复现的操作流程评估。我们呼吁学界重新思考机器人评估方式，将透明化、流程化与可复现的评估体系作为下一代具身智能发展的基石。

title: MMUSV-Sim: A Perception-Oriented Simulation and Data-Generation Platform for Multi-USV Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception among multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) combines complementary observations to extend maritime target sensing beyond the view range and field of a single platform. Developing such systems at scale calls for a unified workflow for configurable multi-USV scenarios, multimodal acquisition, and shared annotations. We present MMUSV-Sim, a perception-oriented maritime simulation and data-generation platform built on Unreal Engine 5 and Project AirSim. It provides island, open-sea, and port environments; configurable weather, time of day, and wave conditions; a diverse vessel asset library; and spline-based multi-vessel motion. MMUSV-Sim acquires RGB, depth, semantic, LiDAR, and radar observations across multiple USVs and captures a common world state for per-agent annotation export. Experiments verify that the configured wave settings produce the intended changes in vessel heave, roll, and pitch, and evaluate the geometric consistency between projected annotations and semantic renderings. In LiDAR-based cooperative BEV vessel detection experiments on the generated multi-USV dataset, Early Fusion achieves an AP@0.5 of 72.74, compared with 45.54 using a single USV.
tldr: MMUSV-Sim is a simulation platform built on Unreal Engine 5 and AirSim for generating multi-USV cooperative perception data, supporting multi-modal sensor acquisition and configurable maritime environments, validated through LiDAR-based BEV detection experiments.
tldr_zh: MMUSV-Sim是一个基于Unreal Engine 5和AirSim构建的多无人水面艇协同感知仿真与数据生成平台，支持多模态传感器采集和可配置海洋环境，通过基于激光雷达的BEV检测实验验证了其有效性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
多无人水面艇（USV）的协同感知通过整合互补观测数据，将海上目标感知范围扩展至单一平台视场与视野之外。要实现此类系统的大规模开发，需要一套统一的工作流程，以支持可配置的多USV场景、多模态数据采集及共享标注。本文提出MMUSV-Sim，一个基于虚幻引擎5和Project AirSim构建的面向感知的海事仿真与数据生成平台。该平台提供岛屿、开阔海域及港口环境；支持可配置的天气、时段及波浪条件；拥有多样化的船舶资产库；并实现基于样条线的多船运动控制。MMUSV-Sim可跨多艘USV采集RGB、深度、语义、激光雷达及雷达观测数据，并捕获统一的全局状态以生成每个智能体的标注文件。实验验证了所设定的波浪参数能引起船体垂荡、横摇与纵摇的预期变化，并评估了投影标注与语义渲染之间的几何一致性。在基于激光雷达的协同BEV船舶检测实验中（使用生成的多USV数据集），早期融合方法实现了72.74的AP@0.5，而单USV方法的对应结果为45.54。

title: OpenBelief-Nav: Evidence-Preserving Object Memory for Open-Vocabulary Language-Guided Navigation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs provide compact semantic memory for language-guided navigation, but mapped objects are often exposed through a single fused feature or committed semantic label. Such commitment can remove minority yet task-relevant hypotheses from the task-time interface. We present OpenBelief-Nav, an evidence-preserving object memory that retains observation-level phrases, reliability cues, and frame-mask provenance while maintaining separate aggregate geometric and visual representations. Semantically related phrases are consolidated into a vocabulary-independent object belief from which task-specific readouts perform fixed-vocabulary projection or free-form retrieval. On five ScanNet200 and eight Replica scenes, full-belief projection achieves mIoU scores of 0.2742 and 0.2912, compared with 0.2393 and 0.2701 for a matched early-commit readout. Across 78 HM3D-YCB navigation trials, consensus and early-commit retrieval each achieve 60/78 successes, compared with 58/78 for belief-weighted retrieval and 55/78 for DualMap. Across 20 Unitree G1 runs organized as 10 matched evaluation cases, a correction policy permitting at most two verified candidate attempts improves target-confirmation success from 6/10 to 8/10 relative to top-1-only execution. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://openbelief-nav.github.io/.
tldr: OpenBelief-Nav introduces an evidence-preserving object memory for open-vocabulary language-guided navigation, retaining observation-level phrases and reliability cues to improve task-specific readout and target-confirmation success on real robot trials.
tldr_zh: OpenBelief-Nav 提出了一种保留证据的对象记忆机制，用于开放词汇语言引导的导航，通过保留观察级短语和可靠性线索，提升了任务特定读取和目标确认的成功率。
summary_zh: 开放词汇三维场景图能为语言引导的导航提供紧凑的语义记忆，但已映射的物体通常仅通过单一融合特征或确定的语义标签暴露出来。这种确定性处理可能将少数但任务相关的假设从任务时接口中移除。我们提出OpenBelief-Nav，一种保留证据的物体记忆方法，它在维护独立的聚合几何与视觉表征的同时，保留观测级短语、可靠性线索及帧掩码来源。语义相关的短语被整合为与词汇无关的物体信念，任务特定读取器可从中执行固定词汇投影或自由形式检索。在五个ScanNet200和八个Replica场景上，全信念投影的mIoU得分分别为0.2742和0.2912，而匹配的早期确定读取器得分为0.2393和0.2701。在78次HM3D-YCB导航试验中，共识检索与早期确定检索各实现60/78次成功，而信念加权检索为58/78次，DualMap为55/78次。在20次宇树G1运行（组织为10组匹配评估案例）中，允许最多两次验证候选尝试的修正策略，将目标确认成功率从仅取首位的6/10提升至8/10。代码将在接收后于https://openbelief-nav.github.io/ 发布。

title: Ontology-Grounded World Models for Failure Diagnosis and Closed-Loop Repair in Physical AI Systems
summary: EV-WM represents candidate quality with feature and event scores, but these scores do not explicitly record an unmet task predicate, a route label for an available correction mechanism, or a post-correction acceptance result. We present Onto-EV-WM, an ontology-grounded diagnosis and verification-gated correction interface layered above EV-WM rather than a replacement world-model architecture. The implemented task-local TBox defines entity types, predicate signatures, and constraints; source-specific grounding maps predicted or simulator-observed states to task ABoxes; and deterministic rules retain each missing predicate and its arguments when assigning a route label. Learned or heuristic proposers remain separate from this symbolic interface; native task predicates determine acceptance, and the bounded protocol determines whether a failed verification is retried. In the aligned PointMaze evaluation, EV-WM and Onto-EV-WM both report 94% success, with mean final-state distances of 0.90573 and 0.61177, respectively; the separately budgeted search reaches 100% success. On LIBERO-Goal, the ontology represents failed task conditions as typed records, retains their predicate arguments, and associates them with the declared source/joint correction route and predicate-gated acceptance; the complete configuration reports 93.8% corrected-window success on seed 0 and 94.05 +- 0.30% across four evaluation-sampling seeds. On the fixed 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus registry, Onto-EV-WM succeeds on 8,526 tasks (85.00%), with suite-level success rates of 65.98% for LIBERO-10, 91.39% for LIBERO-Goal, and 91.38% for both LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial. These numbers report the performance of the complete ontology-grounded configurations under the tested simulator protocols; an ontology-only causal share is not measured separately, and real-robot recovery is not evaluated.
tldr: This paper introduces Onto-EV-WM, an ontology-grounded interface layered above EV-WM that adds symbolic failure diagnosis and closed-loop repair for Physical AI systems, demonstrating improved success rates and lower final-state distances in PointMaze, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Onto-EV-WM，一种基于本体论的接口，叠加在EV-WM之上，为物理AI系统添加符号故障诊断和闭环修复能力，在PointMaze、LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Plus基准测试中展示了更高的成功率和更低的最终状态距离。
summary_zh: EV-WM通过特征评分和事件评分来表征候选质量，但这些评分并未明确记录未完成的任务谓词、可用修正机制的路径标签，或修正后的接受结果。我们提出Onto-EV-WM——一个基于本体的诊断与基于验证的门控修正接口，该接口构建于EV-WM之上而非替代其世界模型架构。所实现的局部任务TBox定义了实体类型、谓词签名和约束；面向特定数据源的映射将预测或仿真器观测的状态转化为任务ABox；确定性规则在分配路径标签时保留每个缺失谓词及其参数。学习型或启发式提议系统独立于该符号接口；原生任务谓词决定接受条件，有界协议则决定验证失败后是否重试。在对齐的PointMaze评估中，EV-WM和Onto-EV-WM均报告94%的成功率，平均最终状态距离分别为0.90573和0.61177；单独预算的搜索策略达到100%成功率。在LIBERO-Goal上，本体将失败任务条件表示为类型化记录，保留其谓词参数，并将其与声明的数据源/联合修正路径和谓词门控接受条件相关联；完整配置在种子0上报告93.8%的修正窗口成功率，在四个评估采样种子上达到94.05±0.30%。在固定包含10,030个任务的LIBERO-Plus注册库上，Onto-EV-WM成功完成8,526个任务（85.00%），其中LIBERO-10的套件级成功率为65.98%，LIBERO-Goal为91.39%，LIBERO-Object和LIBERO-Spatial均为91.38%。这些数据报告了在测试仿真器协议下完整基于本体配置的性能表现；未单独测量仅由本体带来的因果贡献，也未评估真实机器人的恢复能力。

title: Coverage Aware Active Evaluation for Failure Discovery with Paired Systems
summary: Autonomous systems can fail in rare and heterogeneous ways, making real-world failure discovery difficult under limited testing budgets. Although cheaper proxies such as simulators, lower-fidelity systems, or related policies can be sampled extensively to find failures, proxy failures often do not transfer to the real world due to sim-to-real and system-to-system gaps. The key challenge is therefore to effectively leverage proxy system information for accurate prediction of severe target system failures. We propose an adaptive failure discovery method that combines proxy evaluations with limited target system results to guide scenario selection for target system testing. Our method learns a local predictor of target risk by correcting proxy failure signals using control-variate-inspired residual modeling. To find failures that are both likely and diverse, we combine this predictor with a support-aware mutual-information objective that favors realistic, well-supported regions while expanding coverage across failure modes. Across autonomous driving, manipulation, and quadruped velocity-tracking tasks, our method discovers up to 2$\times$ as many failures as random sampling and active-learning baselines, including severe and diverse failures missed by competing methods.
tldr: Proposes an adaptive failure discovery method that leverages proxy system evaluations and limited target system tests to find diverse, severe failures in autonomous systems, achieving up to 2x more failures than baselines across driving, manipulation, and locomotion tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种自适应故障发现方法，利用代理系统评估和有限的目标系统测试来发现自主系统中的多样且严重的故障，在驾驶、操作和运动任务上比基线方法多发现多达2倍的故障。
summary_zh: 摘要：自主系统可能出现罕见且多样化的故障模式，在有限测试预算下，这使得在真实场景中发现故障变得困难。尽管可以通过模拟器、低保真系统或相关策略等低成本替代手段进行大量采样来寻找故障，但由于仿真与现实之间的差距以及系统间的差异，这些代理故障往往无法迁移至真实环境。因此，关键挑战在于如何有效利用代理系统信息，准确预测目标系统的严重故障。我们提出一种自适应故障发现方法，该方法将代理评估与有限的目标系统结果相结合，以指导目标系统测试的场景选择。通过采用受控制变量启发的残差建模技术修正代理故障信号，我们构建了一个目标风险的局部预测器。为同时发现高概率且多样化的故障，我们将该预测器与支持感知互信息目标相结合，该目标倾向于选择具有现实支撑且覆盖充分区域、同时能扩展至各类故障模式的场景。在自动驾驶、机械臂操作及四足机器人速度跟踪等任务中，我们的方法发现的故障数量是随机采样和主动学习基线方法的2倍，包括被其他竞争方法遗漏的严重且多样化的故障。

title: Traj-LeWM: Path-Aware World-Model Planning via Latent Trajectory Cost
summary: LeWM is a lightweight visual world model that learns latent dynamics end-to-end from pixels and ranks candidate action sequences by the distance between their predicted endpoints and the goal. However, LeWM has two limitations. First, during training, it learns local next-step transitions without evaluating complete trajectories relative to the task goal. Second, during planning, it ranks candidates solely by predicted endpoint distance. Because model predictions may differ from actual execution outcomes, the candidate whose predicted endpoint is closest to the goal may not perform best when executed in the environment. The evolution of the complete predicted trajectory can therefore provide complementary information beyond endpoint distance. To address these limitations, we propose Traj-LeWM, which retains LeWM's local-dynamics objective and endpoint score while introducing a goal-conditioned latent trajectory cost (LTC) that aggregates trajectory-level information as a complementary signal. During training, LTC-based trajectory-preference supervision complements next-step prediction in shaping the shared representation. During planning, LTC is combined with endpoint distance to incorporate intermediate-path information into candidate ranking. With joint endpoint-plus-LTC scoring, Traj-LeWM outperforms LeWM on Push-T, OGBench-Cube, Reacher, and Two-Room by $3$, $14$, $7$, and $7$ percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments and ablations further verify the complementary roles of trajectory-level representation shaping and path-aware candidate ranking.
tldr: Traj-LeWM enhances a lightweight visual world model by adding a goal-conditioned latent trajectory cost (LTC) that incorporates trajectory-level information during both training and planning, improving manipulation and navigation task performance.
tldr_zh: Traj-LeWM通过在训练和规划过程中引入目标条件化的潜在轨迹成本（LTC），融合轨迹级信息，从而提升了轻量级视觉世界模型在操作和导航任务中的表现。
summary_zh: LeWM是一种轻量级视觉世界模型，能够从像素中以端到端方式学习潜在动态，并根据候选动作序列的预测终点与目标之间的距离对其进行排序。然而，LeWM存在两个局限性：第一，在训练过程中，它只学习局部下一步转移，而不评估与任务目标相关的完整轨迹；第二，在规划过程中，它仅依据预测终点距离对候选序列进行排序。由于模型预测可能与实际执行结果存在差异，预测终点最接近目标的候选序列在实际环境中执行时未必表现最佳。因此，完整预测轨迹的演化过程可以提供超越终点距离的补充信息。为解决这些问题，我们提出Traj-LeWM，该模型保留了LeWM的局部动态目标和终点分数，同时引入了目标条件潜在轨迹成本（LTC），将轨迹级信息聚合为互补信号。在训练阶段，基于LTC的轨迹偏好监督补充了下一步预测对共享表征的塑造作用；在规划阶段，LTC与终点距离相结合，将中间路径信息纳入候选序列排序中。通过终点分数与LTC的联合评分，Traj-LeWM在Push-T、OGBench-Cube、Reacher和Two-Room任务上分别比LeWM提升了3、14、7和7个百分点。控制实验和消融研究进一步验证了轨迹级表征塑造与路径感知候选排序的互补作用。

title: IRGNN: Efficient Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for Radar Point Cloud Object Detection
summary: Perception is a fundamental component of autonomous driving systems. While LiDAR-based methods have achieved remarkable progress in object detection, their reliability can degrade under adverse weather conditions. Radar point clouds provide a robust alternative due to their resilience to bad weather and low-illumination scenarios. However, radar point clouds are typically sparse, unordered, and less informative than LiDAR data, making it challenging to directly apply existing LiDAR-based perception methods. To address these challenges, we propose IRGNN, an Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for radar point cloud object detection. IRGNN first reconstructs radar point clouds into graph representations using translation- and rotation-invariant feature designs, enabling robust modeling of sparse radar measurements. It then employs an improved message passing neural network (MPNN) with residual connections and a virtual node layer to enhance local feature propagation and global context modeling. Finally, task-specific heads are applied to the learned graph representations for object classification and bounding box prediction. Experimental results on the RadarScenes dataset show that IRGNN outperforms existing radar-based object detection methods and achieves competitive performance. In addition, IRGNN significantly reduces computational cost and memory usage during inference, demonstrating its effectiveness and practical potential for efficient radar-based perception in autonomous driving.
tldr: Proposes IRGNN, a graph neural network with invariant features for efficient radar point cloud object detection in autonomous driving, outperforming prior radar methods on RadarScenes with lower cost.
tldr_zh: 提出IRGNN，一种具有不变性特征的图神经网络，用于自动驾驶中高效的雷达点云目标检测，在RadarScenes上优于现有雷达方法且计算成本更低。
summary_zh: 感知是自动驾驶系统的基本组成部分。尽管基于激光雷达的方法在目标检测领域已取得显著进展，但其在恶劣天气条件下的可靠性会降低。雷达点云因对恶劣天气和低光照场景具有鲁棒性，成为稳健的替代方案。然而，雷达点云通常稀疏、无序、且信息量远少于激光雷达数据，这使得直接应用现有激光雷达感知方法面临挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出IRGNN——一种面向雷达点云目标检测的不变雷达图神经网络。IRGNN首先利用平移和旋转不变的特征设计，将雷达点云重构为图表示，从而对稀疏雷达测量值进行稳健建模；随后采用改进的残差连接消息传递神经网络（MPNN）与虚拟节点层，增强局部特征传播与全局上下文建模；最后将任务特定头应用于学习到的图表示，完成目标分类与边界框预测。在RadarScenes数据集上的实验结果表明，IRGNN优于现有基于雷达的目标检测方法，并达到竞争性性能。此外，IRGNN在推理过程中显著降低了计算成本与内存占用，展示了其在自动驾驶中实现高效雷达感知的有效性与实际应用潜力。

title: Expected Free Energy-based Informative Path Planning for Robotic Mars Exploration
summary: An autonomous robot efficiently exploring an unknown environment, such as looking for water sources on Mars, faces two simultaneous demands: building an accurate information map while quickly finding the regions of greatest value, and paying for every meter of travel and the cost of every measurement it takes. Classical information-seeking and reward-seeking criteria address only one of these objectives at a time. Here, we propose Expected Free Energy (EFE), the principled action-selection objective from active inference, as a unifying criterion for budgeted robotic informative path planning. Maintaining a Gaussian-process belief over the information field, our agent plans continuous trajectories that minimize expected free energy under hard path-length constraints. The results from multiple realizations show that EFE-based planning yields accurate posterior maps and locates the highest-value regions simultaneously, outperforming information-theoretic baselines under the same settings. In robotic exploration, these unified, easy-to-tune principled information-gathering strategies facilitate autonomous deployment while enforcing efficiency and resource constraints.
tldr: This paper applies Expected Free Energy from active inference to budgeted informative path planning for robotic Mars exploration, unifying information- and reward-seeking objectives under a Gaussian process belief.
tldr_zh: 本文将主动推理中的预期自由能应用于预算受限的火星探索机器人信息路径规划，在高斯过程信念下统一了信息寻求和奖励寻求目标。
summary_zh: 一个自主机器人在未知环境中高效探索时（例如在火星上寻找水源），面临两项同时存在的需求：构建精确的信息地图，同时快速定位价值最高的区域，并且需要为其每米行进距离和每次测量成本付费。经典的信息搜索与奖励搜索准则每次仅针对其中一项目标。在此，我们提出预期自由能（EFE）——源于主动推理的基于原则的行动选择目标——作为预算约束下机器人信息路径规划的统一准则。我们的智能体在信息场上维护高斯过程信念，并在严格路径长度约束下规划连续轨迹以最小化预期自由能。多次实验的结果表明，基于EFE的规划能够同步生成精确的后验地图并定位最高价值区域，在相同设定下优于信息论基线方法。在机器人探索中，这些统一且易于调节的原则性信息收集策略，能够在强制执行效率与资源约束的同时，促进自主部署。

title: THRIVE: Therapeutic Humanoid Robot In Virtual Environment
summary: This paper presents THRIVE (Therapeutic Humanoid Robot In Virtual Environment), an at-home rehabilitation platform that integrates a suite of virtual-reality upper-body rehabilitation games, a real-time camera-based motion-tracking system, and a socially interactive robot therapist. The system is designed for therapy and intervention in children with upper-limb motor impairments, which can be improved through consistent, task-specific practice. THRIVE features a set of newly designed, engaging games that target functional reaching, grasping, and object-manipulation movements through customizable popping, hitting, catching, and grabbing tasks, while the camera-based tracking system captures the child's kinematic performance during play. A robot therapist - deployable either as a physical robotic coach or as a remote-presence virtual agent - delivers adaptive, dynamic feedback to motivate the child and guide their movements toward therapeutic goals. THRIVE decouples the therapeutic games from the robot embodiment, extending the platform to support various embodiments and different robots within one modular system. This robot-agnostic design makes THRIVE affordable, scalable, and readily adaptable for sustained use in the home, offering a practical pathway to more consistent and engaging upper-limb therapy for children with motor function impairments.
tldr: THRIVE integrates VR rehabilitation games, camera-based motion tracking, and a socially interactive robot therapist into a unified at-home platform for children with upper-limb motor impairments.
tldr_zh: THRIVE 将VR康复游戏、摄像头运动追踪和社交互动机器人治疗师整合为一个统一的居家平台，用于上肢运动障碍儿童的治疗。
summary_zh: 本文提出THRIVE（虚拟环境下的治疗型人形机器人）系统，这是一个集成了套件化虚拟现实上肢康复游戏、基于摄像头的实时运动追踪系统以及社交互动型机器人治疗师的家庭康复平台。该系统专为上肢运动障碍儿童的治疗与干预而设计，其运动功能可通过持续、针对性的任务训练得到改善。THRIVE包含一系列全新设计的趣味游戏，通过可定制的戳击、击打、抓取和抢夺任务，针对性地训练功能性够取、抓握及物体操控动作，同时基于摄像头的追踪系统可捕捉儿童在游戏过程中的运动表现。机器人治疗师——既可部署为实体机器人教练，也可作为远程临场虚拟代理——提供适应性动态反馈，以激励儿童并引导其动作向治疗目标靠近。THRIVE将治疗性游戏与机器人具身形态解耦，使平台能在单一模块化系统中支持多种具身形态及不同机器人。这种机器人无关的设计使THRIVE具备经济性、可扩展性，且易于适应家庭场景的持续使用，为运动功能障碍儿童提供更持久、更具吸引力的上肢治疗实践路径。

title: Vibration Suppression in Collaborative Flexible Payload Manipulation Using Passive Force Control
summary: In large and heavy structures, vibrations arise during motion, posing significant challenges for precise manipulation. To accomplish the desired motion, control algorithms must effectively suppress these structural vibrations. In cutting edge projects, such as remote maintenance of future fusion energy reactors (tokamaks), the manipulation of this type of structure is defined as a crucial task. This paper presents a control strategy to suppress transverse vibrations in flexible payloads during motion using a collaborative payload manipulation approach. Two different industrial robot arms are arranged in a leader follower configuration for the manipulation strategy. The leader robot guides the motion with shaped velocity commands, while the follower robot ensures compliance with the estimated external forces applied by the leader on the payload through an admittance controller. Unlike existing methods, the proposed approach enables collaborative manipulation of heavier and larger flexible objects, addressing additional challenges such as vibration suppression and heterogeneous robot specifications. The dynamics of the leader follower payload system are modeled using an equivalent mass spring damper model, and it is shown that, with appropriate admittance parameters, the total energy of the system is passively dissipated. A stability proof is also provided. Numerical simulations validate the proposed method, and experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.
tldr: This paper proposes a passive force control strategy for suppressing transverse vibrations in flexible payloads manipulated by two heterogeneous industrial robots in a leader-follower configuration, validated through simulations and experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种被动力控制策略，用于在两个异构工业机器人以领导者-跟随者配置操作的柔性负载中抑制横向振动，并通过仿真和实验验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 在大型重型结构中，运动过程中会产生振动，这对精确操控构成了重大挑战。为实现期望的运动，控制算法必须有效抑制这些结构振动。在尖端项目中，例如未来聚变能源反应堆（托卡马克）的远程维护，此类结构的操控被定义为关键任务。本文提出一种协同负载操作策略，用于抑制运动过程中柔性负载的横向振动。两个不同的工业机械臂采用主从配置进行操控：主机械臂通过整形速度命令引导运动，而从机械臂则通过导纳控制器保持对主机械臂施加在负载上的估计外力的顺应性。与现有方法不同，本方法能够协同操控更重、更大的柔性物体，同时解决了振动抑制和异构机器人规格等额外挑战。采用等效质量-弹簧-阻尼模型对主从负载系统的动力学进行建模，结果表明，在适当的导纳参数下，系统总能量被被动耗散。此外还提供了稳定性证明。数值仿真验证了所提方法，实验结果证明了其有效性。

title: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. For training, we use competitive self-play with Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) and a diversified opponent pool, enabling agents to improve against historical policies while stabilizing optimization and reducing policy oscillation. This process leads to the emergence of sophisticated pursuit and evasion strategies. For real-world deployment, we develop a hardware-aligned simulation pipeline that models actuator-response dynamics, communication latency, and domain randomization. The learned policies transfer zero-shot to real quadrotors without task-specific tuning. Real-world experiments reproduce pursuit-evasion tactics observed in simulation, including rapid dodging and flanking, and demonstrate interactive two-agent zero-shot deployment.
tldr: UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play RL with direct thrust/body-rate control, zero-shot sim-to-real deployment on quadrotors.
tldr_zh: 通过自我对弈强化学习实现无人机追逃，直接输出推力/机体角速率指令，零样本从仿真迁移到真实四旋翼。
summary_zh: 自主追逃是无人飞行器（UAV）面临的一项基础性挑战，要求在强耦合动力学与对手行为持续变化的场景下进行快速决策。传统基于规则或微分博弈的方法难以应对高维度空中交互与敏捷机动。我们提出AgilePE——一个通过自博弈强化学习实现自主无人机追逃的完整系统。该系统在统一框架中集成了敏捷低层控制、竞争性策略优化以及仿真到现实部署。策略直接将机载状态观测映射为合推力与机体角速率（CTBR）指令，无需中间轨迹规划器或航点控制器即可实现端到端的敏捷机动。训练阶段采用基于优先虚拟自博弈（PFSP）的竞争性自博弈与多样化对手池，使智能体在对抗历史策略时持续提升，同时稳定优化过程并减少策略振荡，最终催生出复杂的追逃策略。针对现实部署，我们开发了硬件对齐的仿真流水线，可建模执行器响应动力学、通信延迟及域随机化。学习所得策略无需任务特定调参即可零样本迁移至真实四旋翼飞行器。实际实验复现了仿真中观察到的追逃战术（包括快速闪避与侧翼包抄），并成功演示了双智能体交互的零样本部署。

title: PILOT: Privileged Imitation Learning for End-to-End Motion Planning of Autonomous UAVs under Partial Observability
summary: Autonomous navigation in cluttered environments is hampered by partial observability and dynamic constraints. This paper presents PILOT, a constraint-aware privileged imitation learning framework for vision-based end-to-end UAV motion planning under partial observability. The framework distills planning strategies from a computationally intensive optimal control expert into a student policy regularized toward safety and dynamic requirements via a dual-objective loss function. To mitigate partial observability, a spatiotemporal perception fusion module using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is developed to integrate historical depth images and odometry. This module infers task-relevant latent context from historical observations, enhancing spatial awareness beyond the instantaneous FOV without maintaining persistent map memory. A trajectory parameterization layer mapping network outputs to a structured trajectory, while enabling explicit continuity, dynamic-consistency, and obstacle soft penalties during training, encouraging constraint satisfaction for unseen observations without formal guarantees. Simulations on quadrotor and fixed-wing aircraft demonstrate that PILOT achieves performance comparable to the privileged expert while reducing computational overhead by over 80\%. Successful indoor and outdoor zero-shot deployment confirms the practical feasibility and cross-domain generalization of the planner.
tldr: Presents PILOT, a privileged imitation learning framework for vision-based autonomous UAV motion planning that distills an optimal control expert into a low-latency student policy with explicit constraint awareness, achieving expert-level performance and zero-shot cross-domain deployment.
tldr_zh: 提出了PILOT，一种用于视觉自主无人机运动规划的特权模仿学习框架，将最优控制专家蒸馏为具有显式约束感知的低延迟学生策略，实现了专家级性能与零样本跨域部署。
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中进行自主导航受到部分可观测性和动态约束的阻碍。本文提出PILOT框架，一种面向部分可观测条件下基于视觉的端到端无人机运动规划的约束感知特权模仿学习框架。该框架通过双目标损失函数，将计算密集型最优控制专家的规划策略蒸馏为受安全性和动态需求正则化的学生策略。为缓解部分可观测性，开发了基于时序卷积网络（TCN）的时空感知融合模块，用于整合历史深度图像与里程计信息。该模块从历史观测中推断任务相关潜在上下文，在不维护持久地图记忆的情况下增强超出瞬时视场（FOV）的空间感知能力。所设计的轨迹参数化层将网络输出映射为结构化轨迹，同时在训练过程中显式保证连续性、动态一致性及障碍物软惩罚，促使模型在无形式化保证的条件下满足未知观测的约束。在四旋翼与固定翼飞行器上的仿真表明，PILOT在实现与特权专家相当性能的同时，将计算开销降低80%以上。成功的室内外零样本部署验证了该规划器的实际可行性与跨领域泛化能力。

title: Communication in modular robotic motor control: Bilateral controllers under realistic constraints
summary: Robotic motor control in musculoskeletal systems requires fast, accurate movement and robust postural stabilization under signal-dependent noise (where motor command variance scales with command magnitude) and energetic cost. Modular controllers can distribute these competing demands across interacting submodules, but it remains unclear whether they outperform monolithic architectures under realistic constraints, and how inter-module communication shapes the resulting strategy. Inspired by the bilateral hemispheric organization of the brain, we introduce a recurrent controller of two GRU-based modules connected by a learnable, delayed inter-hemispheric channel, trained end-to-end in a differentiable two-arm musculoskeletal simulator. Across reaching and holding tasks, the modular architecture substantially outperforms a capacity-matched monolithic baseline. Compared to a matched modular controller without communication, learned inter-hemispheric communication reshapes the solution: improved endpoint precision, lower energetic cost in non-zero-delay regimes, and reduced muscle co-contraction. Our findings show that for robotics, biologically inspired modular controllers offer a practical route to robust movement under noise and energetic constraints, with inter-module communication providing a mechanism to tune trade-offs between precision, stability, and actuation cost.
tldr: This paper introduces a biologically inspired modular recurrent controller with a learnable delayed inter-module communication channel for robotic motor control in a musculoskeletal system, showing that it outperforms monolithic and non-communicating modular baselines in precision, energy cost, and co-contraction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种受生物启发的模块化循环控制器，具有可学习的延迟模块间通信通道，用于肌肉骨骼系统中的机器人运动控制，在精度、能量成本和共收缩方面优于单片和非通信模块化基线。
summary_zh: 在肌肉骨骼系统的机器人运动控制中，需在信号依赖噪声（即运动指令方差随指令幅度增大而增大）及能量消耗约束下，实现快速精准的运动与鲁棒姿态稳定。模块化控制器可将这些相互冲突的需求分配至相互作用的子模块，但在实际约束条件下其性能是否优于单体架构，以及模块间通信如何塑造最终策略，目前尚不明确。受大脑双侧半球组织结构的启发，我们提出了一种由两个基于GRU的模块构成的循环控制器，两模块通过可学习且具有延迟的半球间通道连接，并在可微分的双臂肌肉骨骼模拟器中以端到端方式完成训练。在到达与保持任务中，该模块化架构显著优于容量匹配的单体基线模型。与无通信的同等模块化控制器相比，学习到的半球间通信重塑了解决策略：端点精度提升，在非零延迟条件下能量消耗降低，且肌肉共收缩减少。研究结果表明，对于机器人领域而言，受生物启发的模块化控制器为在噪声与能量约束下实现鲁棒运动提供了实用途径，而模块间通信则为调节精度、稳定性与驱动成本之间的权衡提供了机制。

title: Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance
summary: Interactive game world models typically autoregress visual observations directly in pixel or latent space, forcing structured properties such as pose, geometry, and occlusion to be implicitly maintained by the same generative sequence. Over long horizons, errors in these latent world properties accumulate, making consistency and controllability fragile. We explicitly model the evolving world state, delegate exact geometric computation to a fixed, zero-parameter renderer, and leave the neural model to synthesize appearance. We instantiate this idea as Marionette, a world model for interactive games with articulated characters. First, a two-stage autoregressive dynamics model predicts an explicit and interpretable 276-dimensional 3D world state comprising multi-entity articulated skeletons, metric root trajectories, and rotations. Second, a zero-parameter graphics bridge converts the predicted state into pose-control videos, computing world-space geometry and occlusion in closed form. Third, a control-conditioned video-diffusion observation model synthesizes photorealistic RGB observations from the resulting structured controls. Our experiments establish two properties of Marionette. First, the predicted world state is directly controllable. Forcing a mismatched action stream changes root-aligned joint error by 31% across 48 held-out segments. Second, long-horizon behaviour is determined in the state, and can be repaired there. Left free, the two generated characters drift to 21.2 m apart (recorded sessions stay near 5 m) and a third of frames show ground penetration. Two rules imposed on the explicit state, a terrain collider and a separation cap, cut penetration by 66% and keep the pair engaged, with no change to the observation model. Routing appearance through the predicted state costs no fidelity we can detect, at an FVD of 831 against 799 for recorded pose.
tldr: Marionette predicts an explicit 3D world state (skeletons, trajectories) using a dynamics model, then renders geometry with a fixed renderer and synthesizes appearance with a video diffusion model, improving long-horizon controllability and consistency for interactive game worlds.
tldr_zh: Marionette 先预测显式的 3D 世界状态（骨架、轨迹），然后用固定渲染器计算几何，最后用视频扩散模型合成外观，从而提升了长程可控性和一致性。
summary_zh: 交互式游戏世界模型通常直接在像素或潜在空间中自回归地观测视觉信息，迫使姿态、几何和遮挡等结构化属性由同一生成序列隐式维持。在长时域中，这些潜在世界属性的误差不断累积，导致一致性和可控性变得脆弱。我们显式建模演化的世界状态，将精确的几何计算委托给固定的零参数渲染器，仅让神经模型负责外观合成。我们将这一思想实例化为Marionette——一个面向含关节角色的交互式游戏世界模型。首先，两阶段自回归动力学模型预测出显式且可解释的276维3D世界状态，包含多实体关节骨骼、度量根轨迹和旋转量。其次，零参数图形桥接器将预测状态转换为姿态控制视频，以闭式解计算世界空间几何与遮挡。第三，控制条件视频扩散观测模型从生成的结构化控制中合成逼真的RGB观测结果。实验确立了Marionette的两个特性：首先，预测的世界状态可直接控制——强制施加不匹配的动作流可使48个保留片段中根对齐关节误差改变31%；其次，长时域行为由状态决定并可在状态层面修复。在无约束情况下，两个生成角色相距漂移至21.2米（记录会话保持约5米），且三分之一帧出现地面穿透现象。通过对显式状态施加地形碰撞体和分离上限两条规则，穿透率降低66%且角色保持交互，而观测模型无需任何改动。通过预测状态路由外观不会造成可检测的保真度损失，其FVD值为831，而记录姿态的FVD为799。

title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
summary: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all levels. Replay validation happens in a twin world model. The harness enforces that an action is not made until the program reproduces every previous observed game transition. Each mismatch between a world model prediction and the actual action result becomes a counterexample that is used to repair the world model. Twin clears 179 out of 183 levels (97.8%), and does so more efficiently than humans in 158 out of 179 levels (88.3%). The system infers the goal before any reward on 156 of the levels it clears (87.2%), and in the remaining levels automatically discovers the goal by search. The benchmark scores completion and action efficiency, between 0 and 100, against humans playing each game for the first time. Played directly, the base model scores only 7.8%; an off-the-shelf harness increases it to 61.1%, whereas our twin world model increases the same base model to 93.3%, clearing 23 out of 25 games. Building a usable world model is simpler than anticipated, whereas the harder problem is inferring the right goal.
tldr: Twin introduces a test-time world model inference system that uses a coding agent to build an executable world model from simulation and interaction, achieving high performance on ARC-AGI-3 games by repairing the model through counterexamples.
tldr_zh: Twin 提出了一种测试时世界模型推理系统，通过编码代理从模拟和交互中构建可执行的世界模型，利用反例修复模型，在 ARC-AGI-3 游戏中取得了高性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种测试时世界模型推理（Twin）系统，其中前沿编码智能体可编写可执行的世界模型，用于完成持续学习任务（如 ARC-AGI-3 游戏）。传统方法采用人工设计模型，每个任务需定制专属方案。每款游戏隐藏其规则与目标，而我们的系统仅通过仿真与交互即可构建这些要素。其对网格游戏存在的归纳偏置足够强大，能在几乎所有关卡中恢复游戏的真实转移规律与目标。回放验证在孪生世界模型中进行。测试框架确保只有程序能复现所有先前观察到的游戏转移时，才允许执行动作。世界模型预测与实际动作结果之间的每次不匹配都会成为反例，用于修复世界模型。Twin 系统通过了 183 个关卡中的 179 个（97.8%），并在其中 158 个关卡中（88.3%）比人类更高效。系统在通过关卡的 156 个（87.2%）中于任何奖励信号出现前即推断出目标，其余关卡则通过搜索自动发现目标。该基准测试按照 0 至 100 分制，评估首次游玩每款游戏的人类与系统的通关率及动作效率。基础模型直接运行时仅得 7.8%；使用现成测试框架可提升至 61.1%；而采用我们的孪生世界模型后，同一基础模型得分跃升至 93.3%，通过了 25 款游戏中的 23 款。构建可用世界模型比预期更简单，而更困难的问题在于推断正确目标。

title: Effect of Twisted-Yarn Architecture on Pressure and Proximity Sensing Characteristics of Textile Capacitive Sensors for Robotic Skin
summary: Textile-integrated capacitive sensors offer flexible and conformable tactile sensing for wearable electronics and human-robot interaction; however, the influence of yarn-level architecture on capacitive transduction characteristics remains insufficiently quantified. This work presents a textile capacitive sensing platform based on silver-coated yarns coated with polydimethylsiloxane and assembled into one-, two-, and four-layer twisted configurations. The influence of effective electrode overlap area and inter-fiber separation on the capacitive response is systematically investigated, enabling architecture-dependent tuning of pressure and proximity sensing characteristics. Pressure was calculated using the localized single-fiber contact area, corresponding to stresses of 0.4-3.9 MPa. Increasing the layer number improved mechanical strength and sensing performance: elongation at break increased from 37.5% to 62.5% and 85.0%, while the maximum load increased from 23.3 to 42.7 and 89.7 N. Sensitivity increased with layer number and frequency, reaching 0.1331 MPa$^{-1}$ for the four-layer sensor at 100 kHz. The four-layer configuration also exhibited low hysteresis, minimal thermal drift from 25 to 90 $^\circ$C, and stable operation over 15,000 cycles. Proximity detection ranges of 60, 50, and 40 mm were obtained for the one-, two-, and four-layer sensors, respectively, revealing an architecture-dependent sensitivity-range trade-off. A 4$\times$4 textile sensing array enabled spatial contact mapping, while robotic-arm integration demonstrated real-time touch and proximity detection with an end-to-end robotic system latency (from detection to robot reaction) of 403 ms. The results establish yarn architecture as a tunable design parameter governing the measurement characteristics of textile-integrated capacitive sensing systems.
tldr: This paper systematically investigates how the twisted-yarn architecture of textile capacitive sensors affects their pressure and proximity sensing characteristics, demonstrating tunable performance and integration onto a robotic arm for real-time touch and proximity detection.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究纺织电容传感器的加捻纱线结构如何影响其压力和接近感应特性，展示了可调性能，并集成到机械臂上实现实时触觉与接近检测。

title: Accelerating Large-scale Bundle Adjustment for LiDAR Mapping via Parallel Computing
summary: LiDAR bundle adjustment is widely utilized in mapping to construct globally consistent point cloud maps. In this paper, we propose the first fully parallel computing framework to accelerate LiDAR bundle adjustment for large-scale mapping, incorporating three key techniques. First, we design an adaptive, asynchronous data loading strategy to efficiently process large-scale point cloud datasets on memory-constrained GPUs. Secondly, we present a novel bottom-up voxelization method for extracting planar features, enabling fully parallelized pre-processing. Thirdly, we build upon a majorization-minimization formulation to accelerate compute-intensive tasks in the optimization via parallel computation, including the computation of residuals, Jacobian and Hessian matrices, and a parallel increment solver. To support our design, we provide both theoretical and experimental analysis of the time complexity of our approach. Extensive benchmarking on large-scale public datasets across various computational platforms validates the robustness and adaptability of our approach, achieving up to a tenfold improvement in computational efficiency while preserving mapping accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods. To benefit future research, the implementation code is available on GitHub.
tldr: This paper proposes a fully parallel computing framework for LiDAR bundle adjustment that accelerates large-scale mapping by leveraging GPU parallelization for data loading, feature extraction, and optimization, achieving up to tenfold speedup while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于LiDAR光束法平差的完全并行计算框架，通过GPU并行化数据加载、特征提取和优化过程，加速大规模地图构建，在保持精度的同时实现高达十倍的效率提升。

title: A Temporal Barrier Framework for Collision Avoidance in Multi-Agent Autonomous Aerial Vehicles
summary: Operating teams of autonomous aircraft in dynamic, uncertain, and potentially adversarial environments requires safety protocols that are reliable yet selective, and allow agents to fly in close proximity while making progress toward mission objectives. We introduce adversarial time-to-collision (aTTC), a risk metric that quantifies, for a given agent, how quickly any surrounding agent could reach it assuming adversarial intent. We embed aTTC into the control barrier function (CBF) framework, defining the barrier directly in time rather than distance or velocity. The resulting aTTC-CBF is inherently anticipatory: agents modulate their own velocity based not on whether a peer is on a collision course, but on how quickly one could reach collision given its dynamical constraints. A differentiable neural-network surrogate makes the aTTC computable in real time within a standard CBF quadratic program. Across long time-horizon simulations of 3D independent-pursuit and formation-flight scenarios, the aTTC-CBF achieves up to twice the waypoint progress at half the collision rate of a higher-order distance-based CBF baseline.
tldr: This paper introduces a temporal barrier function (aTTC-CBF) for collision avoidance in multi-agent aerial vehicles, replacing distance-based safety constraints with a time-to-collision metric that is robust to adversarial moves and that doubles waypoint progress while halving collision rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于多智能体飞行器避碰的时间势垒函数（aTTC-CBF），用碰撞时间指标替代基于距离的安全约束，可抵御对抗性移动，在将碰撞率减半的同时使航点进度翻倍。

title: Demonstration of Space Robot Teleoperation over a Lossy and Delayed Network using ATMOS
summary: We present a demonstration showcasing the Autonomy Testbed for Multi-purpose Orbiting Systems (ATMOS), a planar spacecraft-analog robot designed for hardware-in-the-loop evaluation of guidance and control strategies in microgravity-like conditions. Using ATMOS as the physical test platform, we investigate the design, analysis, and performance evaluation of control architectures for remotely operated spacecraft under round-trip communication delays. In this work, we develop and experimentally validate a control strategy that combines state prediction and trajectory tracking control to perform a docking maneuver, accounting for time-varying random communication latency between ground operators and the ATMOS system. The demonstration includes a long-distance remote control experiment between Seoul and Stockholm, introducing realistic intercontinental delays and variability. The results highlight the capability of ATMOS to support rapid, reliable, and cost-effective testing of spacecraft teleoperation concepts, establishing a first step toward robust validation of on-orbit operations in microgravity-like environments.
tldr: This paper presents ATMOS, a planar spacecraft-analog robot platform, and validates a control strategy combining state prediction and trajectory tracking for teleoperated docking under realistic intercontinental communication delays between Seoul and Stockholm.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ATMOS平面航天器模拟机器人平台，并验证了一种结合状态预测和轨迹跟踪的控制策略，可在首尔与斯德哥尔摩之间的真实洲际通信延迟下实现远程操作对接。

title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of each phase. Because prefix processing is independent of the generated response, it can be run alongside rollout decoding, which leaves GPU compute capacity underutilized, without breaking synchronous on-policy semantics.
  We present Rollplex, a runtime that decomposes the reference and training phase and moves the prefix computation into the rollout decode window. Realizing this schedule requires more than concurrent kernel launches: naive colocation of Qwen2.5-VL-32\,B requires roughly 165\,GiB per GPU, while rollout and training prefer different tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and weight layouts.
